raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?c
  where all
    match
      relation "be a ninth grade class at"
      role subject ?c
      role object "Colegiul Național «Mihai Viteazul» din Ploiești"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have students"
      role subject ?c
      role object ?n
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?n above 28
  during "the 2026–2027 school year"
